topics.reason: A viral video sparked a massive investigation into alleged daycare fraud in Minnesota, with federal resources being deployed to investigate.
A defendant connected to Feeding Our Future is linked to taxpayer-funded group homes in the Twin Cities, and a judge has approved a $5.2M restitution amount for the former founder.
Governor Tim Walz is facing criticism and calls for resignation amid allegations that he turned a blind eye to daycare fraud in Minnesota.
Minnesota has added an extra review to high-risk Medicaid programs amid fraud concerns, following a surge in investigations into alleged fraud.
There are allegations of a vast network of Somali nonprofits being involved in Minnesota's welfare fraud scandal, with some calling for deportations.
